technology_type.value: affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
technology_type.evidence: inferred: The PVDF membrane was blocked and incubated with FLAG-tagged Amuc_0904 protein or buffer overnight. FLAG was detected using Immobilon Western Chemiluminescent HRP Substrate. The corresponding differenced bands from buffer and Amuc_0904 on SDS-PAGE were excised for mass spectrometry protein identification.
